name: app-authentication-flow-four-phones-on-pale-grey-with-blue-gradient
title: Authentication Flow in Four Phones
whatItIs: A white page with an 'Authentication' pill, a headline with an italic serif 'Financial Journey', a paragraph, four link pills (Create, Login, Verify, Home) and four phones in a cross layout showing create account, welcome back, OTP verify and home, each fading from white to blue-grey at the base.
whatItMeans: A gradient rising in each screen makes a serious flow feel soft, and the cross layout shows the sequence at a glance.
techniques: Phones in a cross or diamond arrangement
Blue-grey gradient rising from the bottom of each screen
Rounded white inputs on soft backgrounds
Small pill navigation for the flow steps

vocabulary.definition: A screen for entering a one-time code.
Small labels naming the steps in a flow.
A colour gradient that strengthens toward the bottom.
